Tooltip.use: auxiliary description for a control that already has its own accessible name

placement.block-start: opens above the trigger, the tooltip default
placement.block-end: opens below when the space above is tight
placement.inline-start: opens toward the start edge, alongside the trigger
placement.inline-end: opens toward the end edge, alongside the trigger

interactive.true: the pointer can move into the tooltip without it closing, required for WCAG 1.4.13 hoverable content
interactive.false: closes as soon as the pointer leaves the trigger; only turn off knowingly

rules.children: The child control must already carry its own accessible name (visible text or aria-label); the tooltip only extends it, it never replaces aria-labelledby.
rules.content: Keep content short: a tooltip is a hint, never the only place information lives, since it never opens on touch and never appears without JS.
rules.interactive: Leave interactive on unless you have measured that the content never needs to be read by pointer.

Tooltip.icon-only: <Tooltip content="Exportar el periodo visible en CSV"><Button aria-label="Exportar" iconOnly variant="ghost"><DownloadIcon /></Button></Tooltip>
Tooltip.placement: <Tooltip arrow content="Texto completo truncado arriba" placement="inline-end">Billing pipeline migration</Tooltip>
